label: Trump wins the 2024 presidential election
description: His direct call, stated as seen, that Trump wins on 5 November 2024: in April 2024 that from what he saw Trump would be in the White House, and on 1 November 2024 that he had seen it so clearly that it was settled.
aliases: president Trump wins and I've seen it
he's going to be in the white house

label: Brazil's October 2026 election is rigged
description: Seen in October 2026: an attempt to rig Brazil's presidential election, major election fraud, three gunny sacks of fraudulent paper ballots in a metal garage.
aliases: try to rig the election in Brazil
gunny sacks full of fraudulent paper ballots

label: Change comes to Brazil and the conservative wins
description: That change is coming to Brazil and that the conservative candidate with a heart like David should win the October 2026 election, said partly in prayer and partly as what the Lord showed.

label: The conservative wins Colombia by a landslide
description: Prayer in June 2026 that the conservative Christian candidate wins Colombia's presidential election by a landslide.
aliases: win by a landslide in Colombia
